name: PhotoEditor
description:
A window-sized photo editor. It fills its parent, so a dialog, a window or a page section sets its
size. It saves nothing by itself: `onSave` receives the result and the host stores it.
signature: ({ src, tools, title, saveLabel, header, footer, labels, canvasLabel, backend, className, ...options }: PhotoEditorProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: actions
props.description: Host action overrides; matching ids replace or hide built-ins.

props.name: assets
props.description: Host-owned decoded assets, shared with project adapters.

props.name: backend
props.description: Force a rendering backend. By default the best available is used.

props.name: canvasLabel
props.description: An `aria-label` for the canvas.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: filters
props.description: Filters beyond those the tools bring, in the order they apply.

props.name: footer
props.description: Draw the bottom bar. Turn it off to place `PhotoEditorStatus` elsewhere.

props.name: header
props.description: Draw the title bar. Turn it off when a window or dialog supplies one.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ canvasLabel: string; canvasHelp: string; opening: string; openFailed: string; tools: string; crop: string; rotate: string; adjust: string; undo: string; noUndo: string; noRedo: string; redo: string; reset: string; zoomIn: string; zoomOut: string; fit: string; actualSize: string; zoomPercent: (percent: string) => string; size: ({ width, height }: { width: string; height: string; }) => string; cancel: string; close: string; save: string; saving: string; saved: string; saveFailed: string; discardTitle: string; discardBody: string; discardConfirm: string; keepEditing: string; rotateLeft: string; rotateRight: string; flipHorizontal: string; flipVertical: string; brightness: string; contrast: string; saturation: string; warmth: string; sharpen: string; aspectRatio: string; aspectFree: string; aspectOriginal: string; aspectSquare: string; aspectFourThree: string; aspectWide: string; width: string; height: string; applyCrop: string; removeCrop: string; cropArea: string; cropHelp: string; cropReadout: ({ x, y, width, height }: { x: string; y: string; width: string; height: string; }) => string; toolSelected: (tool: string) => string; resetTool: (tool: string) => string; nothingToReset: string; }> | undefined
props.description: Replace any built-in words.

props.name: layerKinds
props.description: Opt-in source providers for recipe layer kinds.

props.name: onAction
props.type: ((action: ActionRequest, next: (args?: unknown) => unknown) => unknown) | undefined
props.description: Runs for every action. Call `next` to let it go ahead, or don't to stop it.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called when the host cancellation action runs.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with each committed change.

props.name: onDirtyChange
props.description: Reports whether committed edits differ from the last saved state.

props.name: onError
props.description: Reports operational loading, rendering or delivery failures to the host.

props.name: onExport
props.description: Explicit export delivery. The host decides whether to download, upload or persist it.

props.name: onSave
props.description: Receive the lazy edited result and cancellable delivery context. No storage occurs without this callback.

props.name: open
props.description: Controls whether the overlay is open.

props.name: recipe
props.description: An earlier edit to continue from.

props.name: saveLabel
props.description: Words on the save button, such as "Save to listing".

props.name: src
props.description: The picture: a file, blob, URL or tile source.

props.name: stages
props.description: Opt-in source stages that replay before geometry and filters.

props.name: title
props.description: Shown in the title bar.

props.name: tools
props.description: The tools to offer, in order. Pass only what you need: unused tools stay out of the bundle.
